reasons: Numeric warning signals (2 of 3 computable): two of Beneish M > -1.78, Dechow F > 1.0, accruals > 3% of assets, or operating cash flow < 0.8x net income are triggered, suggesting earnings quality concerns and possible accrual-driven or manipulated results.
Internal control and audit (1 of 4): one flag among material weakness, adverse ICFR opinion, auditor change or disagreement is present, indicating some weakness in the control/audit environment.
Financial pressure (2 of 4): two of going concern, covenant problems, revenue/EPS-linked incentive pay or a capital raise are present, adding motive/pressure for misstatement.

Transaction complexity (3 of 8): three complexity items (e.g. over-time revenue, contract assets, related parties, acquisitions, inventory write-downs, customer concentration) increase judgment-heavy areas where misstatement can occur.

Mitigating: no prior-period corrections or accounting changes (0 of 3), no investigations or litigation (0 of 3), and no management turnover (0 of 2); card gives only aggregate counts without specific F/R IDs, limiting precision, so the score is moderate rather than high.
